the LRIG1 stem cells are the master switch for the development of the acne microcomedone.
the LRIG1 + sebaceous stem cells are the key players in comedone formation and that the key switching factor that triggers the formation of a microcomedone is the androgen receptor.

the acne switch is a switch of a switch.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the acne switch is not the result of a single factor but rather of the concerted action of a multitude of factors.
acne prevention is possible, but it requires a long-term strategy that starts early in adolescence.

acne prevention is possible.
the switch to acne can be avoided by controlling the key switching factors in the long run.
acne is a complex disease with a long latency period and that the prevention of the acne switch is the best way of treating the condition.
